ranged.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: production animation source study for Rasta Quest. Reference image is design and palette reference only. Generate a NEW polished pixel-art BODY-ONLY animation study of ONE consistent actor. Same thin hooded bronze armored crossbow hunter with burgundy torn cape from reference. NO crossbow and NO equipment in any cell; hands posed to grip a separate compact horizontal crossbow. Preserve costume, hood, boots, red cloth, slight nonhuman shadow face.
Exactly 16 poses in four equal columns and four equal rows on a truly transparent background. Entire actor visible and isolated inside every cell with ample gutter, no overlap across cells, no labels/text/checkerboard/grid/shadows/glow. All face LEFT in exact side-view, same camera, scale, head/hip proportions, palette and baseline in every nonfallen cell. Detailed controlled pixel clusters, no blurry anti-aliasing, no crude geometric placeholder. Keep same design across poses; fixed orthographic side camera.
Reading left to right:
row1: subtle idle breath1, subtle idle breath2, walk LEFT heel contact, walk LEFT down/passing.
row2: walk LEFT takeoff/opposite contact, walk LEFT opposite passing, walk LEFT rear toe push, walk LEFT return to contact. These six movement keys form one true leg articulation cycle, not translated duplicates.
row3: anticipation coil1, anticipation maximum2, actual attack release1, attack follow-through2.
row4: small recoil hurt1, recover hurt2, kneeling/crumpling death1, fully fallen readable death2 on common floor. Keep all fallen body within its cell. Character motion only; no damage VFX, projectiles or drawn equipment. Professional cohesive animation draft, not claimed native game export.
